title: phplyr
tagline: A PHP port of the Tidyverse's dplyr and tidyr.
summary: phplyr brings R's dplyr and tidyr to PHP: filtering, grouped summaries, window functions, joins, pivots, and the rest, with dplyr's function names and arguments. Pipelines use PHP 8.5's pipe operator, or method chains on PHP 8.3 and 8.4. They run on phibble's in-memory DataFrame, on databases through SQL, and on Polars.

optional.name: phit extension
optional.for: statistical models and native descriptive statistics

optional.name: PDO driver for SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL

examples.title: Filter rows and add columns
examples.description: Keeps rows with filter() and adds columns with mutate(), using row closures and if_else().

examples.title: Summarize groups
examples.description: Counts, sums, and averages per group with group_by() and summarize(), leaving out missing values.

examples.title: Join two tables
examples.description: Adds matching columns with left_join() and shows how unmatched and repeated keys affect the rows.

examples.title: Pivot between wide and long
examples.description: Moves yearly columns into rows with pivot_longer() and back with pivot_wider().
